Team / Organization accounts Status Completed Subscribe to updates Upvote 101 Right now you have to invite team members on a per site basis, which is tedious when (in our case) you have hundreds of sites. It would be much simpler to have to invite a user to the organization, and then they automatically have access to all the sites. Staylive AB 3 years ago 4 Same boat here - we’d use Plausible a lot more if it was easy to manage a large number of sites. At the moment it is nearly impossible to use it for more than a handful of sites. Hamish.campbell 3 years ago 2 Funny, I tried to create this same issue a few days ago, but the system didn’t save it or somethnig. This was my text: Currently, an account can only have one owner. As an organisation, we have dozens of Plausible profiles, so now we have to invite every person separately to each account. I’d love a solution enabling us to simply invite someone to “all accounts” or “all accounts in custom group X”. Or at least to not have one person being owner, but rather a company account of some sorts.
